paper_metadata.title: The effects of refractory elements on Ni-excesses and Ni-depletions at g(f.c.c.)/g0(L12) interfaces in model Ni-based superalloys: Atom-probe tomographic experiments and first-principles calculations

evidence.quote: The effects of refractory (R) elements (R = Re, Ru, W, or Ta) on a base Ni-Al-Cr alloy are studied
